# MobileOffload
> Educational and commercial resources about Wi-Fi carrier offload for commercial properties and multi-location businesses.

## Core guides
- [Carrier Offload Explained](https://mobileoffload.com/carrier-offload/): Plain-language definition, parties, process, eligibility, and limitations.
- [Can Businesses Get Paid for Wi-Fi?](https://mobileoffload.com/get-paid-for-wifi/): Buyer guide to qualifying carrier-offload programs.
- [Carrier Offload Companies](https://mobileoffload.com/carrier-offload-companies/): Disclosed provider comparison based on primary sources.
- [Carrier Offload Earnings](https://mobileoffload.com/carrier-offload-earnings/): Revenue mechanics, costs, and projection limitations.
- [Passpoint Wi-Fi](https://mobileoffload.com/passpoint-wifi/): Technical guide to Passpoint and Hotspot 2.0.
- [Wi-Fi Compatibility](https://mobileoffload.com/wifi-compatibility/): Enterprise equipment and qualification checklist.

## Company
- [About MobileOffload](https://mobileoffload.com/about/): Business identity, service role, and boundaries.
- [Evidence and Case Studies](https://mobileoffload.com/case-studies/): Evidence policy and current verification status.
- [Network Assessment](https://mobileoffload.com/network-assessment/): Commercial qualification request.

## Editorial notes
- MobileOffload is operated by Goolsby Ventures LLC.
- Participation, compatibility, carrier enablement, traffic, and revenue are not guaranteed.
- Provider claims are identified as provider-reported; unknown details are not inferred.
